description: Close the toaster oven door. | The last attempt completed release/lift and achieved outward clearance but could not reach its heuristic lateral midpoint within the bounded stage. Resume from that measured location after validating original high/exterior guards, open joints and live pad clearance, preserving all remaining closure, alignment, approach and seating stages. This addresses the failed lateral transfer without extending its bound or replaying completed work. Code retains the complete task; syntax checks passed and physical completion remains unverified.
